purpose: host whole-entry sentence-by-sentence precheck of long lore entries before the first EXECUTOR dispatch (window 28 lesson)

items: “领军学者之一—缟玛瑙之子德瑞宝——”破折号不成对，改为“之一——……——”
reaching the surface / in hopes 的“达到”改“到达”
work his skills into a mass-producible artifact → 把技术融入一种可量产的魔法造物（非“工艺品”）
reverse-engineering the Sher'Tul portals → 逆向研究夏·图尔的传送门

P1 there appears to be a particular pattern that teleports him → 有某种特定的魔法模式在传送<?=player:him_her()?>（非“他在使用魔法传送自己”）
P3 the mental hold will break once he's incapacitated → “只要击败<?=player:him_her()?>，那些精神枷锁就会解除”（补逗号断句，避免读成“击败他那些精神枷锁”）

P5 spells that can drain his energy → 吸取<?=player:his_her()?>能量的法术（删增译“生命”）；ripping away his shield → 夺走/击碎<?=player:his_her()?>护盾（删增译“用缴械技能”，shield 此处为魔法护盾语境不明时用“护盾”）

leaps on … face, clutching it tight … then lets go → 扑到……脸上、紧紧抓住……然后松开（非“踩在”，补 lets go）
patch him up（两处）→ 给他疗伤/治好他；Clean him and patch him up → 把他洗干净并治好
apparently it missed your eyes, because you can see … → 显然它没溅到你的眼睛，因为你还看得见……
Structural damage subpar → 结构伤害低于预期
You know you're not supposed to scream during this next part → 你知道接下来这一段你不该尖叫
tearing off bits of it as you try to get the acid off → 补“撕下一块块皮肤”
your skin still bubbles / stops bubbling → 仍在冒泡 / 不再冒泡
your handler … muttering a healing spell under his breath, and your scars slowly start to fade into smooth skin once again → 看管你的恶魔低声念着治疗法术，你的伤疤渐渐褪去、重新变得光滑
target's overwhelming badassery → 目标的“霸气”不写死“他”（用 <?=player:his_her()?> 或省略主语）
isolating <?=player.name?> → 隔离 <?=player.name?>；Blow all connectors → 炸毁所有连接；break platform off the continent → 把平台从大陆上分离
The last O trails off … like the pen was rapidly jerked away → 最后一个 O 拖出一条线直到页尾，仿佛笔被猛地拽走
double-bladed katana → 双刃武士刀；giant construct labelled "Ninja Atamathon" → 标着“忍者阿塔玛森”的巨型构装体
Your badassery must have interrupted this demon's writing → 你的霸气一定打断了这个恶魔的书写（删“吓尿了”）
children of ruby / emerald / onyx → 红宝石之子 / 绿翡翠之子 / 缟玛瑙之子（本库统一称谓）
holding the front lines against the hordes of Eyal → 在前线抵御埃亚尔的大军；study new magical spells for our arsenal → 为我们的武库研究新法术
making new constructs from scratch, lashing flesh, magic, and steel together into towering creations → 从零打造新的构装体，把血肉、魔法与钢铁捆扎成高耸的造物
Forge-Giant-produced armor bolted onto their skin at “birth” → 一“出生”就被铆上锻造巨人打造的护甲
very much machines, made with bolstered muscles without losing the clever minds they come from / As eager as they are brilliant / well-disciplined and capable in combat → 逐句补全（非“钢铁般的纪律”）
cannot be overstated, except by claiming it to be infinite → 乌鲁洛克的力量怎么夸大都不为过——除非说它是无限的（删“不过不幸的是”增译）
he cannot spend time or effort → 他无法（非“或许没有”）；small portion of his power 删增译“父亲大人”
granted their request in full, giving them a handful of enormous hammers → 完全应允，赐予他们几把巨锤
modified variants … built for raw strength at the expense of speed and energy-efficient creation → 以速度和制造时的能耗效率为代价换取蛮力（非“能量燃率”）
heating raw metal … until it is workable, then pounding it into their shape → 用魔法把原料金属加热到可锻打，再捶打成形（非“导入模具”）
every single swing produces several pieces of usable equipment → 每一锤都能产出数件可用装备（非“零件”）；almost absurdly formidable → 强大得近乎荒谬
should our scouting parties encounter … sending a Forge-Giant down is a reliable emergency option → 若侦察队遇到……派一名锻造巨人下去是可靠的应急手段（非“只有……才会”）
recovered an intact one → 找回一座完好的传送门（删“早已”）；in hopes of reaching Eyal → 希望到达埃亚尔
tear any prospective passengers apart → 撕碎任何打算穿行的旅者（非“你”）
too awful to risk inflicting on other test subjects → 失败后果太过可怕，他不愿让其他受试者冒险，于是亲自进入
